collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: A musician wonders whether distant people could speak with loved ones too far away to hear a shout.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A musician wonders whether distant people could speak with loved ones too far away to hear a shout.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A whispered message changes meaning as it passes from person to person, revealing a serious weakness.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A researcher speculates about sound transformed into something that travels invisibly, but has no evidence it is possible.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder asks how such a device could preserve privacy; the imagined invention acquires new complications.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A parent imagines simply asking a distant child whether they ate enough.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A villager says immediate contact might make people feel obliged to answer constantly; others nod.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: The village devises a clever relay of drums and signals across the shore.
